page_title: LYO 2-3 PSG | Lyon v PSG 09/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Martin Satriano (Lyon) gets a yellow card, off the field.
90+6' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.

90+5' 2 - 3 Goal! The ball is swung into the box from the resulting corner kick and finds Joao Neves (PSG), who jumps highest and tries his luck with a header from around the penalty spot. His effort is both strong and precise enough to go into the top of the net. The score changes to 2:3.
90+5' We are about to witness a corner kick, another promising situation.
90+5' The free kick from long range, taken by PSG, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes behind for a corner. PSG will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+3' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
90+3' The match has ended for Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) as he picks up his second yellow card and referee Benoit Bastien pulls out a red card!
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
87' Dominik Greif (Lyon) is able to continue to play.
86' Dominik Greif (Lyon) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
86' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Benoit Bastien who sees an offensive foul.
84' Lyon fail to score from a corner as Lucas Chevalier (PSG) leaps to collect the ball.
84' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lyon.
83' Lyon can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
83' A lofted cross from Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Lyon will take a corner kick.
80' Afonso Moreira (Lyon) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
79' Adam Karabec (Lyon) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
79' Ilya Zabarnyi (PSG) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Benoit Bastien no option but to blow his whistle.
78' Substitution. Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) has come on for Khalis Merah.
76' Joao Neves (PSG) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar.
74' Here is a change. Khvicha Kvaratskhelia is going off and Luis Enrique gives the last tactical orders to Goncalo Ramos (PSG).
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) is coming onto the pitch as Fabian Ruiz cannot continue after picking up an injury.
74' Tyler Morton (Lyon) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
74' Substitution. Lucas Hernandez will be replaced by Marquinhos (PSG).
73' Tyler Morton (Lyon) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
67' Luis Enrique decides to make a substitution. Senny Mayulu will be replaced by Quentin Ndjantou (PSG).
67' Corner kick. Kang-In Lee (PSG) is ready to send the ball into the box.
66' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The linesman points to the corner flag, PSG are going to take it.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Adam Karabec (Lyon) replaces Rachid Ghezzal.
62' Kang-In Lee (PSG) takes a short corner kick.

62' A sweet pass finds Kang-In Lee (PSG) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom left corner. Dominik Greif is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. PSG force their opponents to concede a corner.
61' Rough tackle by Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
57' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
57' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Tyler Morton (Lyon) was quite harsh and Benoit Bastien didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
56' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lyon.
55' The free kick from long range, taken by Lyon, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Lyon will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
53' Afonso Moreira (Lyon) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
50' 2 - 2 Goal! Tyler Morton finds Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) on the edge of the area, he times his run to perfection and beautifully chips the ball over the goalkeeper. 2:2.
48' Senny Mayulu (PSG) commits a foul and Benoit Bastien immediately signals a free kick.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Kang-In Lee (PSG), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

45+4' This shall not pass! Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. PSG will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45+3' Afonso Moreira (Lyon) commits a foul during an attacking move.
45+1' Senny Mayulu (PSG) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Clinton Mata (Lyon) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Benoit Bastien had an easy-decision to make.
43' Rachid Ghezzal (Lyon) swings in a cross from the corner, but Lucas Chevalier reads it well and gathers the ball.
42' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) takes a nice first touch to control a cross and shoots at goal from near the penalty spot, but his effort only hits the right-hand post!
41' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) sends a cross into the box, but Dominik Greif comes off his line to gather the ball.
37' PSG are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
33' 1 - 2 Goal! Some very poor defending from the opponent allows Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) the chance to get to the edge of the box and he makes no mistake with a lovely finish. It's 1:2.

30' 1 - 1 Afonso Moreira (Lyon) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Lucas Chevalier is just a bystander as the ball flies into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:1.
30' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Lyon as the referee indicates there was no infringement!
29' There's a break in play and referee Benoit Bastien must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Lyon using VAR. This could be interesting!
29' Surely that's handball by one of the PSG players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
28' The resulting set piece from Lyon is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
26' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Vitinha plays it into the box, and Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the roof of the net. 0:1.
23' Rachid Ghezzal (Lyon) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
19' Willian Pacho (PSG) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar.
19' PSG take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

18' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. PSG have been awarded a corner kick.
15' Rachid Ghezzal (Lyon) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
12' Senny Mayulu (PSG) times his run well and connects with a cross on the edge of the six-yard box, but can't keep the ball down and it flies high over the bar.
10' Lucas Hernandez (PSG) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
8' Dangerous play by Senny Mayulu (PSG). Benoit Bastien blows his whistle for a foul.
5' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
3' PSG keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Lyon will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Benoit Bastien.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
Show lineups
